conf.description: GitLab (self-managed) audit / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: gitlab-self-managed / audit / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (httpjson/REST collector input + logs-gitlab.audit@custom mapping the API schema onto the integration's ECS targets). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
